title: Faithful Federated Tabular Data Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.33403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic data is an important data source in the AI era. This paper studies the generation of mixed-type tabular synthetic data in federated settings, where two key challenges arise: ensuring distributional fidelity and effectively handling mixed-type data. We propose Federated Integrative Two-Step Synthesis (FITS), a framework for mixed-type tabular data synthesis. At its core is a two-step federated algorithm for estimating conditional cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) using local linear regression. Building on this algorithm, we develop a federated synthesis procedure based on the probability chain rule to ensure distributional fidelity. To handle mixed-type data, FITS introduces a continualization method that lifts discrete variables into a continuous space and recovers their discrete distributions without loss at both the density-function and CDF levels. translated_title: 高保真联邦表格数据合成
translated_abstract: 合成数据是人工智能时代的重要数据来源。本文研究了联邦环境下混合类型表格合成数据的生成问题，其中面临两大关键挑战：确保分布保真度以及有效处理混合类型数据。我们提出了FITS（联邦整合两步合成），一个用于混合类型表格数据合成的框架。其核心是一种两步联邦算法，利用局部线性回归来估计条件累积分布函数（CDF）。基于该算法，我们开发了一种基于概率链式法则的联邦合成程序，以确保分布保真度。为了处理混合类型数据，FITS引入了一种连续化方法，将离散变量提升到连续空间中，并在密度函数和累积分布函数两个层面上无损地恢复其离散分布。这一转换为混合类型数据提供了统一的连续表示……
tldr: 提出FITS框架，通过基于局部线性回归的两步联邦条件累积分布函数估计结合概率链式法则来保证分布保真度，并采用无损连续化方法统一处理混合类型表格数据。
en_tdlr: Proposes FITS, a federated framework that ensures distributional fidelity through a two-step federated algorithm for estimating conditional CDFs via local linear regression and the probability chain rule, while handling mixed-type data with a lossless continualization method.
